text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: A good day to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I, I asked for help making clothes for my
plushie...
But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We're struggling to come up with any
design
ideas. And that's why we're going
to go for a
stroll.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
There's excitement to be found
throughout the
academy, so ideas are
bound to follow. Care to
join us,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not one to turn down a direct invitation,
I decide
to go for a walk with them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Come, this is our first stop.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"In exchange for your cooperation with
future
research, you may observe
whatever you wish
to..." Those were
Tachyon's exact words.
choice_data_list: 勝手に入って大丈夫なところ……？
choice_data_list_en: Is it okay to just walk in here...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This place truly kindles the imagination.
Inside a
dimly lit research facility hidden
deep in the
woods, a vividly colored
mushroom suspended
within a test tube
glows with an odd light—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you're right! And there's a huge
cloud of
smoke, too...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Poof!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And this is our next stop. Here, it will be
possible
to immerse ourselves in nature
without ever
leaving campus.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-um... Bright, can we stop? I think my
bad luck
will get us in trouble again, just
like it did on our
last stop...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there was no trouble at all. Your
imagination
was spot on back there! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's enjoy our next destination to
the
fullest. Come along, let's go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And here we are.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure... But it looks just like the
place I
imagined earlier!
choice_data_list: こんなところあったっけ？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. ♪ Well? Look closely now... Is
this
helping you to picture what you'd
like to make?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Dark, but sparkling, and flowery... I
think I know
what kind of clothes I'd like
to make!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that Rice Shower has a general
design idea,
it's time to get to work. But
there's one problem...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh. One more time. Start over, but
with neater
stitches!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...No, this won't do either. Again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower has been sewing and
undoing her
progress over and over
since we got here. It
seems like
something's bothering her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What's troubling you? It looked to me as
though
you were about to finish the
outfit just now.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You did so much for me, Bright. Helping

brainstorm the design, drafting the
pattern... I
want to do my part and make
the outfit perfect.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But then a loose stitch or a wrinkle turns
up... and
I just can't ignore those. I'm
sorry this is taking so
long!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I shall assist you for as long as
you
need. But, yes... Why don't we try
chanting some
magic words together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It'll help us make progress, one tidy stitch at a time. Let's say, "You will be lovely"... Now then, all together. ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Magic words.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Okay. If it'll help the clothes turn out
cute, I'll
give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: One stitch at a time... You will be lovely! You will become wonderful clothes!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: D-done!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I actually did it! And it came out just
how I
imagined—like a fairy playing in
the forest at
night!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With some help from a few magic
words... Rice
Shower overcomes the
hurdles to sew her clothes
together
surprisingly smoothly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. No, no. I simply offered one
final push at
the end.
choice_data_list: ブライトのおまじないはすごいな
ブライトのおまじないはすごいね
choice_data_list_en: Bright's good luck charm is really something.
Bright's good luck charm really is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When Rice said she wanted to make an
adorable
outfit...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I could tell there would be no stopping
her from
doing just that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And after the first step is taken, all that
remains is
to keep walking. If the second
foot doesn't know
where to go, a little
push is all it takes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
One needn't be fast or confident. A
couple
detours are fine. All that matters
is that you keep
moving.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We wandered our way to Rice's goal one
step at a
time... And what a wonderful
time it was. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get it now... Bright was leading Rice to
believe in
herself—and give her the
strength to carry on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get it now... Bright was leading Rice to
believe in
herself—and give her the
strength to carry on.
choice_data_list: 進み続ける体力も必要だな
進み続ける体力も必要だね
それが達成の秘訣だね！
choice_data_list_en: You also need the stamina to keep pushing forward.
You also need the stamina to keep pushing forward.
So that's the secret to achieving it!
So that's the secret to achieving it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Very true. However, that will not be an
issue.
choice_data_list: 進み続ける体力も必要だな
進み続ける体力も必要だね
それが達成の秘訣だね！
choice_data_list_en: You also need the stamina to keep pushing forward.
You also need the stamina to keep pushing forward.
So that's the secret to achieving it!
So that's the secret to achieving it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I happen to enjoy long, drawn-out
battles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She speaks calmly, but I can't help
sensing both
strength and fortitude in
her words...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-um, thanks! I mean it! Do you have
any other
tips? I want to learn from your
example!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My goodness! Teehee. Hearing you both
say such
kind things really is an honor. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The key to success... You must rest to be
at your
best! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright smiles as she offers some

spontaneous advice. But her ability to
steadily
strive ahead is the real deal,
and I find myself
wanting to learn from
her approach.
